glosses: vision (something seen; an object perceived visually)
vision, sight (the sense or ability of sight)
view (a way of understanding something, an opinion, a theory)

examples.text: En nuestros días ya nadie cree en visiones.
examples.en: Nowadays no one believes in ghosts.
The snow was making it hard to see.

examples.text: Perdí la visión en un ojo.
examples.en: I lost sight in one eye.
